study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Yu et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Behavioral and brain morphological changes before and after hemispherotomy

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used 11 datasets for normative modeling: ABIDE I & II (ABIDE (I+II)), UNC/UMN Baby Connectome Project (HCP-B), Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP), Healthy Brain Network (HBN), HCP-D, Calgary Preschool MRI Dataset, Children School Functions and Brain Development Project, Infant Brain Imaging Study, Multicenter Database on Perinatal Factors in Child Brain-Mind Development, PING, and Pixar Dataset. Patients were recruited from Pediatric Epilepsy Center, Peking University First Hospital (SINGLE-SITE).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The healthy subjects used for normative model estimation were from 11 MRI datasets, including the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange... the UNC/UMN Baby Connectome Project... the Calgary Preschool MRI Dataset... the Children School Functions and Brain Development Project... the Chinese Color Nest Project... the Healthy Brain Network... the Human Connectome Project Development... the Infant Brain Imaging Study... the Multicenter Database on Perinatal Factors in Child Brain-Mind Development... the Pediatric Imaging, Neurocognition, and Genetics... and the Pixar Dataset... Pediatric patients... were recruited... at the Pediatric Epilepsy Center, Peking University First Hospital
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Yu2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Age-adjusted GMV from a normative model; Patients

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: 11 healthy datasets (including ABIDE, HCP-B, devCCNP, HBN, HCP-D and others) were used to train the normative model. The patient dataset (SINGLE-SITE) was used for testing/application.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The GMV images of the 2115 healthy children and our pediatric hemispherotomy patients were used as the training and testing data, respectively.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Yu2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Age-adjusted GMV from a normative model

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: 2115 healthy children were used for training the normative model. No healthy controls were reported as a separate test set.
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.supporting_text: VBM processing was then applied to the remaining 2115 children... The GMV images of the 2115 healthy children... were used as the training... data
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.location: Yu2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Age-adjusted GMV from a normative model

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The healthy cohort included children aged 0.3 to 13.0 years.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: we included T1-weighted images from all healthy children aged between 0.3 and 13.0 years across these datasets
